answer: Reputation Carryover Lock: each new identity starts with zero and inherits the dispute history of any account sharing a device fingerprint, so clones begin with degraded standing. The first fraudulent action forfeits accumulated mesa credits, which only transfer through continuous honest activity. Every clone also triggers a comet-linked escrow that ties payouts to a 90-day hold the attacker must fund per identity. A sable audit then flags shared infrastructure, making each marginal clone cost more in escrowed capital than any attainable gain.
